cards.mood: The piece opens with a desolate and weary atmosphere, established by a sparse instrumental texture that mirrors a sense of isolation.
cards.palette: A clean electric guitar with a slight overdrive serves as the melodic anchor, playing blues-inflected riffs and chordal structures from the Intro through to the Outro.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the white and silent land
With a heavy heart and a frozen hand
The wind is howling a low, lonesome cry
Underneath the weight of a gray, heavy sky
[Pre-Chorus]
Shadows stretch long across the floor
I don't hear the knocking at my door
[Chorus]
The road is long and the shadows deep
Promises are secrets that I have to keep
The fire is dying in the grate
I’m carrying the burden of a heavy fate
[Verse]
The whiskey tastes like copper and old regret
The memories are scenes I haven't finished yet
A single candle flickers in the hall
I watch the evening shadows start to fall
[Pre-Chorus]
The clock is ticking slow and steady
I'm waiting for the tide to turn steady
[Chorus]
The road is long and the shadows deep
Promises are secrets that I have to keep
The fire is dying in the grate
I’m carrying the burden of a heavy fate
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The ghosts of yesterday are calling my name
Nothing ever changes, but nothing stays the same
[Chorus]
The road is long and the shadows deep
Promises are secrets that I have to keep
The fire is dying in the grate
I’m carrying the burden of a heavy fate
[Outro]
